subject: Request: VAT ID recheck + supplier authorization for reverse-charge on multi-entity invoice
messages:
From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@bluesprout.co>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: VAT treatment confirmation + supplier authorization for reverse-charge

Hi Kimberly,

Quick one from finance — we're preparing to pay Redwood for August usage but need confirmation on VAT treatment before releases. BlueSprout is registered for VAT in the EU; attached is our VAT certificate for your records (bluesprout_vatid_cert.pdf).

The specific ask: can Redwood provide a written supplier authorization (or counter-signed letter) confirming Redwood will accept reverse-charge on the attached multi-entity invoice (invoice #RWI-2026-08-197)? Our payments team requires an explicit supplier authorization to apply RC to invoices that cover services across our NL/FR/DE entities.

Details you may need from our side:
- BlueSprout VAT: NL123456789B01 (primary)
- Invoiced amount: EUR 48,350 (net) split across NL/FR/DE legal entities
- DocuSign readiness: our CFO can sign a one-page supplier consent if Redwood sends a DocuSign link.

Can you confirm the Redwood billing entity you want on the invoice for RC and whether you can provide the supplier authorization (or point us to the form you require)? We need to release payment this week, so a 48h turnaround would be ideal.

Thanks,
Nina Patel
Finance Operations
BlueSprout Analytics
finance@bluesprout.co

Attachment: bluesprout_vatid_cert.pdf (application/pdf, 128KB)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina.patel@bluesprout.co>, BlueSprout Finance <finance@bluesprout.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 11:04:00 +0100
Subject: Re: VAT treatment confirmation + supplier authorization for reverse-charge

Hi Nina — thanks for the certificate and the heads-up.

Short answers and next steps:
1) Redwood billing entity for EU reverse-charge: Redwood EU Ltd (VAT GB999888777). We can reissue the invoice with Redwood EU Ltd as the supplier entity and include the supplier authorization clause.
2) Supplier authorization: we have a one‑page consent template we prefer (standard language for audit trails). I attached a mapper sheet (BS-MAP-authorization-signer.xlsx) that shows how BlueSprout split the usage by legal entity — please confirm rows 4-6 match your intended charged entities so we can mirror that on our reissue.
3) DocuSign: happy to use DocuSign. If you send the link (or confirm the signers), we'll route to Legal for countersignature immediately. Otherwise, we can send our DocuSign copy for your CFO.

Internal note to Marissa and Connor: can Legal/Finance approve the supplier-consent template below and the reissued invoice flow? Proposed turnaround: reissue by EOD tomorrow, countersign by BlueSprout within 48h, then payment release. We should also mark the invoice as RC-eligible in billing to prevent automated VAT charging.

Proposed supplier authorization language (draft):
"Redwood EU Ltd confirms that, for the purposes of the supplies detailed on invoice RWI-2026-08-197, Redwood EU Ltd will not charge VAT and BlueSprout Analytics will account for VAT under the reverse-charge mechanism in the relevant Member State(s)."

If that's acceptable we'll prepare the DocuSign and the reissued invoice.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
